tieu_de: Frontend Developer ERP Focus, ReactJS, VueJS
dia_chi_raw: Số 669 Điện Biên Phủ, Phường Thạnh Mỹ Tây
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Design and develop high-performance, user-friendly interfaces for ERP systems — including Accounting, Inventory, Manufacturing, HRM, and SCM modules.
Implement UI/UX designs (Figma/Sketch) ensuring consistency, smooth user experience, and alignment with complex ERP workflows.
Build data-heavy ERP screens: multi-step forms, approval flows, financial dashboards, real-time reporting tables.
Integrate APIs (RESTful/gRPC, GraphQL) with ERP backend systems.
Build reusable components and optimize frontend architecture (ReactJS or Vue.js).
Optimize frontend performance, handle real-time data, and ensure responsive design across devices.
Apply best practices in frontend security and performance.
Collaborate with designers, backend engineers, BA/consultants, and QA to deliver high-quality ERP products.
Research and adopt new frontend technologies, contributing to continuous improvements.
yeu_cau:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or related fields.
3.5+ years of experience in frontend development (Senior level preferred: 5+ years).
Experience building or customizing ERP frontend modules is required — Odoo Web Client, ERPNext/Frappe UI, SAP Fiori, or custom ERP is a strong plus.
Familiarity with ERP domain and workflows: GL/AR/AP, purchase-to-pay (P2P), order-to-cash (O2C), inventory management, approval flows.
Proficient in ReactJS or Vue.js (TypeScript preferred).
Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, Styled Components, TailwindCSS.
Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, WebSocket.
Hands-on experience in frontend performance optimization and SEO.
Proficient with Git, CI/CD; Docker is a plus.
Nice to have: 
SSR/SSG (Next.js / Nuxt.js), micro frontend, unit testing (Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library / Vue Test Utils), mentoring experience, Vietnamese accounting standards (VAS) localization.
Strong problem-solving mindset, proactive communication, passion for UI/UX and clean code.
